author: Andrew Newland
title: Arc of Evansville announces expansion - NewsBreak
text:
By Andrew Newland ,
1 hours ago EVANSVILLE, Ind. (WEHT) — The Arc of Evansville is expanding its disability support services with a new location in the heart of the city.
The organization will soon open a third community pathway hub in Haynie’s Corner. They currently operate hubs on north main street and at Washington Square Mall.
Officials say the community hubs give people with disabilities a place to build skills, connect with others and receive individual support in a more inclusive setting.
Renovations are currently underway.
